'''2008 Colorado State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 16 August 2008 at Gryphon Games and Comics, 2020 S. College Rd, Fort Collins, Colorado, with [[Mark VanDriel]] as tournament director.<ref name="sf-21799-314546">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=314546#p314546 Colorado States], AnakinSolo (Mark VanDriel), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192412/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21799.html Internet Archive]</ref> Thirteen players came, two of whom arrived late and did not intend to play.<ref name="sf-21794-327348">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=327348#p327348 Wyoming States 2008!], quesosauce37, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192329/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21794.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Brian Hunter]] won and received the bye into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref> It was held together with the [[2008 Wyoming State Championship]] in Laramie the next day.<ref name="sf-21799-314546" />

== Organization ==

The Players Committee's western calendar first listed the event for Saturday 16 August 2008 at 10:00 am at Colorado State University in Fort Collins, with VanDriel as tournament director under the three-judge system and a $10 entry fee.<ref name="sf-21008-303347">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=303347#p303347 Road to Worlds - Western US - All West States Events/Plans], CategoryOneGames.com (Scott Church), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125190718/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21008.html Internet Archive]</ref> VanDriel's own announcement of 12 July 2008 opened with "SWCCG states returns to THE state for SWCCG" and promised prizes for all participants.<ref name="sf-21799-314546" /> On 18 July he moved the event to Gryphon Games and Comics, to save $15 in room rental and to give the game exposure to a larger gaming community; the new site was less than five minutes from the earlier one.<ref name="sf-21799-316396">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316396#p316396 Colorado States], AnakinSolo (Mark VanDriel), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192412/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21799.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Gryphon Games and Comics, 2020 S. College Rd, Fort Collins, Colorado<ref name="sf-21799-314546" /><ref name="sf-21799-316396" />
* '''Dates:''' 16 August 2008<ref name="sf-21799-314546" />
* '''Time:''' 10:30 am (decklists), first games at 11:00 am<ref name="sf-21799-314546" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-21799-314546" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mark VanDriel]], with the three-judge system<ref name="sf-21799-314546" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />

== Results ==

Fort Collins is about an hour from Laramie, and the Colorado event drew one more player than Wyoming's. Hunter came from Denver with two other players, and two players drove about five hours from Sheridan, Wyoming.<ref name="sf-21794-327348" /> Hunter took the Day 2 bye.<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
